# Feature map

<!-- Generated by `pnpm verify readme` from features.json. Edit that file, not this one. -->

Every product feature, who can use it, where its code lives, the agent instructions and QA playbook that apply, the tests that protect it and the commands that verify it end to end. The source is [features.json](features.json); this page is generated from it. "Skills" here means agent instructions under `.claude/skills/`, not the product's skill catalog.

## How to use it

- Find a feature: `pnpm verify list`, `pnpm verify list --state built --persona "Maya Chen"`, `pnpm verify show <id>`.
- Choose checks for a change: `pnpm verify which --changed` (against `main`) or `pnpm verify which <path...>`.
- Run the isolated QA environment: `pnpm verify env build`, `pnpm verify env seed`, `pnpm verify env start`, then `pnpm verify env stop`. It serves the API and the built web app on port 4410 with its own PGlite data under `.data/qa`.
- Verify: `pnpm verify run <id...> --kind tests|api|browser`. Each run writes a JSON result and a short summary under `.data/verify/runs` (or `--out <dir>`) and exits non-zero when a check failed or errored.
- Keep it current: `pnpm verify check` runs in `pnpm check` and CI. How to update the map with a feature change: [.claude/skills/feature-map/SKILL.md](../../.claude/skills/feature-map/SKILL.md).

## Evidence kinds

- `tests`: the feature's test files with Vitest (domain tables, PGlite scenarios, database integrity). Automated evidence.
- `api`: journey checks in `tools/verify/journeys` against a running server, signed in as seeded personas through the dev sign-in. Real-server evidence without a browser.
- `browser`: the screenshot spec (`apps/web/e2e/screenshots.spec.ts`) narrowed to the feature's routes and personas, including the no-sideways-scroll check. Rendered evidence: the PNGs prove pages render, and a person or agent still has to open and judge them.
- Every check ends as `passed`, `failed`, `skipped` (with the reason, for example no server answering) or `error`. Skipped is never counted as passed.

## Details

### sign-in-session

**Sign-in and session.** People sign in (Entra in production, a persona picker in development), get a server session cookie, and see navigation shaped by their relationships and grants.

- State: built
- Personas: Maya Chen, Rhea Castillo
- May: anyone in the tenant directory signs in
- Refused: requests without a session get 401, writes without the x-requested-with header or from another origin get 403, dev sign-in is refused when AUTH_MODE is entra
- States to check: signed out, signed in with no grants (advisor), signed in with tenant_admin, signed out after sign-out
- Web: `apps/web/src/routes/sign-in.tsx`, `apps/web/src/routes/__root.tsx`, `apps/web/src/routes/_app.tsx`, `apps/web/src/components/shell`, `apps/web/src/lib/session.ts`
- Server: `apps/server/src/auth`, `apps/server/src/http/auth-handlers.ts`, `apps/server/src/http/security.ts`
- API: `auth.devPersonas` (`GET /api/auth/dev/personas`), `auth.devSignIn` (`POST /api/auth/dev/sign-in`), `auth.signOut` (`POST /api/auth/sign-out`), `session.me` (`GET /api/session`)
- Tables: `session`, `person`, `role_grant`
- Agent skills: [.claude/skills/qa/SKILL.md](../../.claude/skills/qa/SKILL.md)
- QA playbook: [.claude/skills/qa/journeys/governance.md#sign-in-and-session](../../.claude/skills/qa/journeys/governance.md#sign-in-and-session)
- Tests (scenario): `apps/server/src/auth/auth.scenario.test.ts`
- Tests (unit): `apps/server/src/auth/return-path.test.ts`
- Tests (web): `apps/web/src/lib/return-to.test.ts`

Verify:

```sh
pnpm verify run sign-in-session --kind tests
pnpm verify run sign-in-session --kind api
```

Gaps:

- Entra sign-in is exercised only against a fake OIDC provider in the scenario test; the QA environment runs dev sign-in.
- The sign-in page is not in the screenshot spec.

### my-plan

**My plan: plans, revision and the closing review.** A coachee drafts a development plan with one to three focus skills, proposes it, an agreer agrees; an agreed plan can be revised back to a draft; the owner records a closing review that an agreer confirms. A review never writes credit or a badge.

- State: built
- Personas: Maya Chen, Sam Rivera, Marcus Hill, Priya Raman, Daniel Okafor
- May: the owner edits title, intent and end date of a non-terminal plan, focus skills only in draft, the agreer (engaged coach, or the leader when there is no coach) agrees, revises and confirms the review, the owner records the closing review
- Refused: anyone but the owner editing the plan (Forbidden), the owner confirming their own review, a skip-level leader confirming (Forbidden), editing a closed plan (Unprocessable), REVISE after a confirmed review (InvalidTransition), another tenant (NotFound)
- States to check: draft, proposed, active, paused, completed, canceled, expired (drafts too, by the sweep), review recorded, not confirmed, review confirmed (fixed)
- Web: `apps/web/src/routes/_app/development.tsx`, `apps/web/src/features/development/development-screen.tsx`, `apps/web/src/features/development/plan-dialogs.tsx`, `apps/web/src/features/development/review-dialog.tsx`
- Server: `apps/server/src/features/development/use-cases.ts`, `apps/server/src/features/development/views.ts`, `apps/server/src/features/development/permissions.ts`, `apps/server/src/features/development/plan-review.ts`, `apps/server/src/features/development/handlers.ts`, `apps/server/src/features/shared/plans.ts`
- API: `development.mine` (`GET /api/development`), `development.of` (`GET /api/people/:id/development`), `development.createPlan` (`POST /api/plans`), `development.updatePlan` (`PATCH /api/plans/:id`), `development.planEvent` (`POST /api/plans/:id/events`), `development.recordPlanReview` (`POST /api/plans/:id/review`), `development.confirmPlanReview` (`POST /api/plans/:id/review/confirm`)
- Domain: `packages/domain/src/lifecycles/plan.ts`
- Tables: `plan`, `plan_skill`, `audit_event`
- Agent skills: [.claude/skills/qa/SKILL.md](../../.claude/skills/qa/SKILL.md)
- QA playbook: [.claude/skills/qa/journeys/plans-and-work.md#my-plan](../../.claude/skills/qa/journeys/plans-and-work.md#my-plan)
- Tests (domain): `packages/domain/src/lifecycles/lifecycles.test.ts`
- Tests (scenario): `apps/server/src/journeys/plan-revise-and-review.scenario.test.ts`
- Browser check: routes development as "Maya Chen"

Verify:

```sh
pnpm verify run my-plan --kind tests
pnpm verify run my-plan --kind api
pnpm verify run my-plan --kind browser
```

### work-roles-values

**Work on a plan: roles and individual values.** The owner or an agreer adds work to a plan, optionally from a published template whose values are copied once; each skill of the work is primary or secondary (at most one primary); an agreer or program owner may set an individual value before the work is observed.

- State: built
- Personas: Maya Chen, Sam Rivera, Jordan Blake, Tom Whitaker, Elena Brooks
- May: the owner and an agreer add and edit work, an agreer or a program owner sets an individual value, with a reason, inside the tenant's range
- Refused: the subject setting a value on their own work, whatever their grants (Forbidden), a skip-level or other leader adding work (Forbidden), two primaries, an unpublished template or a retired skill (Unprocessable), a value out of range, without a reason, on ad hoc work or once an observation is open or signed (Unprocessable)
- States to check: planned, underway, completed, canceled, value set, then fixed once observed, values switched off by the tenant
- Web: `apps/web/src/features/development/work-dialog.tsx`, `apps/web/src/features/development/value-dialog.tsx`
- Server: `apps/server/src/features/development/use-cases.ts`, `apps/server/src/features/development/permissions.ts`
- API: `development.workTemplates` (`GET /api/development/templates`), `development.addActivity` (`POST /api/plans/:id/activities`), `development.updateActivity` (`PATCH /api/activities/:id`), `development.setActivityValue` (`POST /api/activities/:id/value`), `development.activityEvent` (`POST /api/activities/:id/events`)
- Domain: `packages/domain/src/lifecycles/activity.ts`, `packages/domain/src/scoring/values.ts`
- Tables: `activity`, `activity_skill`, `note`, `audit_event`
- Agent skills: [.claude/skills/qa/SKILL.md](../../.claude/skills/qa/SKILL.md)
- QA playbook: [.claude/skills/qa/journeys/plans-and-work.md#work-roles-and-values](../../.claude/skills/qa/journeys/plans-and-work.md#work-roles-and-values)
- Tests (domain): `packages/domain/src/scoring/scoring.test.ts`
- Tests (scenario): `apps/server/src/journeys/work-roles-and-values.scenario.test.ts`
- Browser check: routes development as "Maya Chen"

- State: built
- Personas: Maya Chen, Aisha Bello, Sam Rivera
- May: the owner logs work and revises their reflection

- Agent skills: [.claude/skills/qa/SKILL.md](../../.claude/skills/qa/SKILL.md)
- QA playbook: [.claude/skills/qa/journeys/plans-and-work.md#logging-work](../../.claude/skills/qa/journeys/plans-and-work.md#logging-work)
- Tests (domain): `packages/domain/src/privacy.test.ts`
- Tests (scenario): `apps/server/src/journeys/backdating-bounds.scenario.test.ts`, `apps/server/src/journeys/assistant-screen-boundary.scenario.test.ts`

### returned-request

### void-reversal

**Void and reversal.** A compliance reviewer voids a signed observation; each of its credits gets a reversal row, a badge that no longer meets its own saved thresholds is revoked and re-awarded under the current policy when still met, and every aggregate stops counting it.

- State: built
- Personas: Nina Patel, Maya Chen, Leo Okonkwo
- May: a compliance reviewer voids, with a reason
- Refused: anyone else voiding (Forbidden), deleting a credit (the ledger is append-only)
- States to check: voided, badge revoked, badge re-awarded under the current policy

### scheduler-sweeps

**Scheduler sweeps.** An in-process scheduler expires requests, plans (drafts included), engagements and designations through their lifecycles, screens reflections the after-commit screen missed, and dispatches notifications; every expiry is audited as a system action.

- State: built
- May: the system (no actor) on a schedule
- States to check: expired by the sweep, screened by the sweep within its look-back, idempotent re-run
- Server: `apps/server/src/scheduler/sweeps.ts`, `apps/server/src/scheduler/screening.ts`, `apps/server/src/platform/background.ts`
- Tables: `observation`, `plan`, `engagement`, `notification`
- Agent skills: [.claude/skills/qa/SKILL.md](../../.claude/skills/qa/SKILL.md)
- QA playbook: [.claude/skills/qa/journeys/governance.md#scheduler-sweeps](../../.claude/skills/qa/journeys/governance.md#scheduler-sweeps)

- Tests (unit): `apps/server/src/platform/background-context.test.ts`, `apps/server/src/platform/time.test.ts`

### tenancy-and-roles

**Tenancy, separation of duties and the architecture rules.** Every query is tenant-scoped and composite keys make cross-tenant rows impossible; each sensitive action is allowed only to the capability that owns it; only signing writes credit; every table has a retention class.

- State: built
- Personas: Rhea Castillo, Nina Patel, Nadia Brooks, Maya Chen
- May: each grant its own actions (I31)
- Refused: another tenant's data (NotFound), an action owned by another capability (Forbidden)
- States to check: two tenants side by side
- Server: `apps/server/src/features/shared/mutation.ts`, `apps/server/src/features/shared/relationships.ts`
- Other code: `packages/db/src/schema`, `packages/db/src/retention.ts`, `packages/api/src/api.ts`
- Agent skills: [.claude/skills/qa/SKILL.md](../../.claude/skills/qa/SKILL.md)
- QA playbook: [.claude/skills/qa/journeys/governance.md#tenancy-and-roles](../../.claude/skills/qa/journeys/governance.md#tenancy-and-roles)
- Tests (scenario): `apps/server/src/journeys/two-tenant-leak-sweep.scenario.test.ts`, `apps/server/src/journeys/role-by-action-matrix.scenario.test.ts`
- Tests (integrity): `packages/db/src/integrity.test.ts`, `packages/db/src/retention.test.ts`, `packages/db/src/db.test.ts`
- Tests (unit): `apps/server/src/architecture.test.ts`, `packages/api/src/api.test.ts`

Verify:

```sh
pnpm verify run tenancy-and-roles --kind tests
```

Gaps:

- The QA environment seeds one tenant, so cross-tenant checks run only in the scenario tests.
